title: Hussainiyat ki Baqa hai Hussain Ka matam
body:
HUSSAINIYAT KI BAQA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM kE FATIMA S.A KI DUA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
1. GALE KO CHOOMKE ROTE THE SARWARE AALAM
RASOOL NE BHI KIYA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
2. HARAM KE RONE SE PABANDIYAA'N HATAADE LAYEE'N kE INKE GHAM KI DAWA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
3. BANDHI KALAAYI TO AANKHOU SE KARTE HAIN MAATAM
HARAM ME HOTA RAHA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
4. MILI REHAYI JO AHLE HARAM KO ZINDAA'N SE
BAHEN NE PEHLE KIYA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
5. DHADAK RAHA HAI HAREK DIL SADAE MATAM SE
HAR EK DIL ME BASA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
6. RAHEGA HASHR TALAK YA HUSSAIN ZINDABAAD
RUKEGA YE NA RUKA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
7. NAMAAZE ISHQ PADHENGE HAMESHA AHLE AZA
DILAAYE QURBE KHUDA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
8. YAZEED KO MILI ISSE SHIKAST HAR LAMHA
USI KE GHAR ME HUA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
9. YE AISA GHAM HAI JO DIL KO SUKOON DETA HAI
SABHI GHAMOU'N SE JUDA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
10. KISI KHUSHI KI HAMEIN AB KOI TALAASH NAHI
KHUDA NE HUMKO DIYA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
11. NAMAZEIN USKI kisi haal rad nahi hoteen
JO SHAKSH KARTA ADA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
12. SAKINA BIBI KI MAYYAT PE SAIF RORO KAR
HARAM NE KHOOB KIYA HAI HUSSAIN KA MATAM
